# Source notes

The snapshot files in `sources/` were retrieved on 2026-09-22 from the OVITO
User Manual 3.16.1 site for internal design and compatibility research:

- <https://docs.ovito.org/usage/import.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/usage/viewports.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/usage/rendering.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/usage/export.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/reference/pipelines/modifiers/index.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/reference/file_formats/file_formats_input.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/reference/file_formats/file_formats_output.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/reference/data_inspector/index.html>
- <https://docs.ovito.org/reference/app_settings/index.html>

AtomX does not copy OVITO source code. The catalog is a compatibility and UI
planning document; implementation is original C++ code and uses the project's
existing third-party licenses.
